name: Tennis Player Success and Country GDP
description: This project integrates ATP tennis ranking and player data with USDA ERS country-level real GDP data to examine whether country wealth is associated with tennis player success. The workflow downloads, profiles, cleans, integrates, analyzes, and visualizes the data using Python and Snakemake.
